verdict.rationale: Medusa is open source (MIT, core modules on npm), and Cloud states "you own the project" with no special licenses and BYOC, so leaving and self-hosting is plausible. The Admin API is described by an OpenAPI spec, which offers a programmatic route to pull data out, and Cloud mentions automatic backups. However, nothing in the pack documents a data-export feature, export formats, or a migration-off path for hosted data. Missing for 10: a documented full-data export tool or workflow, open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON/SQL dump) for Cloud-hosted data, a documented process for leaving Medusa Cloud, and independent corroboration that a full export works in practice.
